question: 2026年8月销售额是多少？
reference_sql: SELECT SUM(total_amount) AS revenue FROM ecom_order WHERE create_time >= DATE '2026-08-01' AND create_time < DATE '2026-09-01'

question: 2026年7月订单总数是多少？
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM ecom_order WHERE create_time >= DATE '2026-07-01' AND create_time < DATE '2026-08-01'

question: 2026年8月退款率是多少？
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(CASE WHEN refund_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS refund_count, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN refund_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::numeric / COUNT(*), 4) AS refund_rate FROM ecom_order WHERE create_time >= DATE '2026-08-01' AND create_time < DATE '2026-09-01'

question: 订单总数是多少？
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM ecom_order

question: 销量最高的5个商品是什么？
reference_sql: SELECT o.sku, g.title_zh, SUM(o.buy_num) AS units_sold FROM ecom_order o JOIN ecom_goods g ON g.sku=o.sku GROUP BY o.sku,g.title_zh ORDER BY units_sold DESC,o.sku LIMIT 5

question: 最近的退款率是多少？
reference_sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month',create_time) AS month, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(CASE WHEN refund_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS refund_count, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN refund_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::numeric/COUNT(*),4) AS refund_rate FROM ecom_order GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month',create_time) ORDER BY month DESC
